top_signals.title: Ukraine Claims Attack on Russian Ship off Libyan Coast
top_signals.summary: Video shared by Ukraine shows drones striking a Russian warship and another sanctioned vessel off the coast of Libya. Ukraine claimed responsibility for sinking the vessels in what President Volodymyr Zelenskyy called an exemplary operation in response to Moscow’s war. (Source: Volodymyr Zelenskyy/Ukraine SBU via Storyful)
